body.name: Signed-ratio and Walsh estimators
body.construction: Let \(\widehat q_{zt}\) and \(\widehat r_{zt}\) be the within-\(Z=z\) sample means of \(\mathbf 1\{D=t\}\) and \(Y\mathbf 1\{D=t\}\). Set \(\widehat p_t=\sum_{z\supseteq t}(-1)^{|z|-|t|}\widehat q_{zt}\), \(\widehat m_t=\sum_{z\supseteq t}(-1)^{|z|-|t|}\widehat r_{zt}\), \(\widehat\mu_t=\widehat m_t/\widehat p_t\), and \(\widehat{\boldsymbol\theta}=H(\widehat\mu_t)_{t\in\mathcal B}\).
